answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A lotus of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
